latest_final: A fugitive arranged with an accomplice to hide inside a coffin during a funeral, expecting the accomplice to dig him out after the burial. He knew the coffin would be buried and believed he could escape afterward, but he did not know whose funeral it was. Once buried, he struck a match and recognized the corpse as his accomplice. The accomplice had died before the funeral, so no one was coming to free him; the buried coffin could not be opened from inside. Realizing he was trapped, he died there.
